data.narrative:
Cylib is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Lilian Schwich, Gideon Schwich, and Paul Sabarny. The target has raised €140M+ to date, comprising a €55M Series A round plus €26.1M from NRW and €63.4M from BMWE grants. The climate and energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is applicable to this valuation. Using total capital raised (€140M) as a value proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of €280M. This reflects the expectation that companies advance to subsequent funding rounds at a material premium to prior capital deployed.

The peer-median approach is not applicable; while eight same-sector peers exist, none yielded three or more datapoints within same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier filters. A broader peer-set median would introduce material measurement error and is therefore excluded from triangulation.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of €238M (low) to €322M (high), with a median of €280M. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrower peer comparables and the reliance on stage-progression methodology alone. Grant funding composition and operational traction relative to similarly-staged venture-backed cohorts remain material to ultimate valuation support.
